purpose: Bounded free/public source-redundancy qualification for the existing BSV SOURCE_RECOVERY_CANDIDATE recorded in Dataset Seal #111.
qualification_requirements: Source must be official, free/public, auditable and legally accessible without private credentials.
Exact asset identity must match frozen V2A coin_id=bitcoin-cash-sv and symbol=BSV; ticker equality alone is insufficient.
Physical qualification must confirm that MEXC Spot BSVUSDT is Bitcoin SV rather than an unrelated BSV ticker.
Raw response bytes must be preserved and SHA-256 hashed before normalization.
Provider, pair, endpoint, request parameters, retrieval timestamp, raw hash and parser/schema version must be recorded.
Timestamp semantics/timezone and deterministic schema mapping must be explicit.
Duplicate, missing-bucket, monotonic-time, OHLC and nonnegative-volume QA must pass fail-closed where the source exposes those fields.
Any observed gaps remain evidence and cannot be silently synthesized.
Historical coverage and asset-lifetime sufficiency must be adjudicated under the already-frozen V2A rule without changing denominator, cutoff or methodology.
Any clean MEXC candidate may only be admitted under a separate adjudication; qualification data cannot repair prior PIT snapshots or count as prospective evidence.
No methodology, denominator, threshold, cutoff, clocks or economics may change as part of source recovery.
Any identity/API/schema/continuity failure or insufficient history remains evidence and must not trigger silent substitution.
